title: [Aver] Lesson Detail Navigation - Destination context reload - Previous lesson opened - Header and lesson-specific content replaced
description: AC 01.2 - CRUD - After lesson navigation, BO Lesson Detail reloads destination lesson-specific content instead of persisting source lesson data.
preconditions:
- Logged in to Back Office as HQ or CM Staff with access to Aver lesson detail.
- Recurring lesson chain RC-1001 exists with LES-1001 and LES-1002 containing distinct lesson names, dates, and student lists.
- LES-1002 detail page is open in BO Lesson Detail view mode.
steps_actions:
1. Record the header, schedule information, and student list shown for LES-1002.
2. Click Previous Lesson.
3. Observe the destination lesson header, schedule information, and student list.
steps_result:
1. Source lesson details are visible and identifiable before navigation.
2. BO navigates to the previous lesson detail.
3. Header and lesson-specific content are replaced with LES-1001 data and no stale LES-1002 content remains.
steps_data:
1. source_lesson = LES-1002; source_marker = unique_header_and_student_list
2. action = Previous Lesson
3. destination_lesson = LES-1001
suite: [Aver] BO Lesson Detail Navigation - Context Reload, Labels, and Regression
